set.body:
AGENTS.md is 1500 lines (measured at 8a455fcb). "Coordination and governance" (:630-1494, ~865 lines) is suspended in single-developer mode by its own header; rule 4 alone is :862-1414 (553 lines). Every session loads all of it.

Scope (text moves only; no rule is deleted or reworded):
1. Move "Coordination and governance" items 1-3, 5, 7 verbatim to docs/governance/fleet-mode.md; leave a 5-line pointer stating fleet mode is suspended and where the rules live.
2. Move rule 4 (evidence discipline) verbatim to docs/EVIDENCE.md; leave in AGENTS.md the four-link finding chain table, "read the artifact, not the status", and a one-line index per sub-rule linking to its anchor.
3. Update the Layout table to match build.sbt (add view, corpus, corpus-intake, embed-onnx, embed-bench).
4. Keep Liveness, Single-developer mode, Build and test, Mechanised checks, Design contract, Style in place.

Acceptance: AGENTS.md <= 650 lines; `git diff --stat` shows moves, not rewrites (diff of moved text against the original is empty modulo headings); every "rule N" / "rule 4" cross-reference in AGENTS.md, docs/ and tools/ still resolves (list the grep); owner approval recorded in the commit message.
